title: Dynamic quants of Qwen3.8 27B not using caveman thinking
body:
Initially I had downloaded the Q4_K_M from unsloth and it was using caveman thinking. Then they released the dynamic (and allegedly better) quants and those think in natural language.

How does this happen? Could quantization actually do something like that??

submitted by /u/Glad_Claim_6287
summaryZh: 用户在 LocalLLaMA 社区讨论了 Qwen3.8 27B 的动态量化（Dynamic quants）版本表现。对比传统量化，动态量化能够让模型恢复自然语言格式的思考过程，探讨了量化技术对大模型思维链精度的实质影响。
